definition: An unreal or deceptive appearance, idea, or impression.
author: Leo Tolstoy
quote: A personal, human feeling for a brief moment got the better of the artificial phantasm of life he had served so long.
example_sentence: The figure in the mist was only a phantasm of my tired mind.
